progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on G in Kereshme. The line peaks at D5 (559.9 Hz) at 0:40.6. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (G4 → Fs4 → G4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Ek4).
